headline: Sensex surges nearly 1,000 points while Nifty reclaims 25,500 led by auto and bank stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying interest in banking and auto stocks drove the market rally, sending Bank Nifty to a record high.
Fund managers turned overweight on India for the first time since January, boosting overall market sentiment.
Strong Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) inflows provided robust support to Indian equities.
Buying interest broadened across key sectors as markets recovered from early-session cautiousness.
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points to trade higher alongside Nifty reclaiming the 25,500 mark.
Markets initially opened flat to lower due to concerns over potential US Federal Reserve rate hikes.
Early pressure on IT and metal stocks was overcome as auto and banking sectors led a sharp intraday recovery.
NSE unlisted/stock price rallied 5% on heavy trading volume, extending gains to 35% from its October low.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty bounced back strongly, soaring nearly 1,000 points with Nifty reclaiming the 25,500 level. The rally was spearheaded by bank and auto stocks, with Bank Nifty hitting a record high amid strong FII inflows. Global fund managers also turned overweight on India for the first time since January, bolstering market confidence.
